report_issue_clusters.observed: FinishState has no explicit declaration. Its first mention is PlantUML line 21: `cruise --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2` inside the HighwayMode block, so PlantUML declares it as a child of HighwayMode. It is also used from outside that block: PlantUML line 38: `lane_change_urban --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<0.7`; PlantUML line 46: `UrbanMode --> FinishState : auto_finished=true`. In the closed model those transitions enter HighwayMode and are routed to its child FinishState. Author source: PlantUML line 21: state `FinishState` (implicit declaration); PlantUML line 12: state `HighwayMode` (explicit declaration); PlantUML line 38: `lane_change_urban --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<0.7`; PlantUML line 46: `UrbanMode --> FinishState : auto_finished=true`; PlantUML line 21: `cruise --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2`.
